# Lumina

Lumina is a comprehensive client area/dashboard for Pterodactyl Game Panel, and other platforms. It provides a powerful suite of tools for managing client servers, user accounts, billing, and much more. Based on MythicalDash.

[View the Documentation Here](https://lumina.loners.software)

---

## 🚀 Overview

Lumina provides hosting providers with a complete management solution that integrates with popular hosting panels. The dashboard offers a modern, responsive interface with extensive customization options, security features, and monetization tools.
